newsitem.title: USA: Tampa, Fla., hospital in talks with Tenet.
newsitem.headline: Tampa, Fla., hospital in talks with Tenet.

text.p: TAMPA, Fla., March 13 - Tampa General Hospital, the second-largest public hospital in Florida, is in discussions with Tenet Healthcare Corp concerning a possible operating agreement, the St. Petersburg Times said Thursday.
Joan Galvan, a spokeswoman at Tenet headquarters in Santa Monica, Calif., told Reuters she could not comment specifically on a possible deal with Tampa General.
However, she said, "Florida is a very important market for Tenet. We are in discussions with a number of providers at any given moment."
Hospital officials were unavailable for comment Thursday.

The hospital has been then the focus of state and federal investigations into allegations that former hospital executives devalued its assets in an attempt to encourage a failed purchase attempt by Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp in 1994.
